items.body: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+JP:wght@400;500;700&family=Noto+Serif+JP:wght@400;700&display=swap'); :root { --night: #2a2c5a; --night-dk:#1c1d40; --fire1: #e0567a; } .tochiroku-article { font-family: 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif; background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink); line-height: 1.9; font-size: 16px; padding: 0 0 20px; } .tochiroku-article img { width: 100%; display: block; } .hero { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #3a3c70 0%, #2a2c5a 55%, #1c1d40 100%); padding: 48px 24px 44px; text-align: center; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .hero::before { content: '🎆'; position: absolute; font-size: 7rem; opacity: .14; top: 6px; right: 6%; transform: rotate(-6deg); } .hero::after { content: '🎇'; position: absolute; font-size: 5rem; opacity: .12; bottom: 10px; left: 7%; transform: rotate(8deg); } .hero .breadcrumb { font-size: .72rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,.6); margin-bottom: 16px; position: relative; z-index: 1; } .hero .breadcrumb a { color: rgba(255,255,255,.85); text-decoration: none; } .hero .cat-badge { display: inline-block; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; color: var(--night-dk); background: var(--gold); border-radius: 99px; padding: 4px 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; position: relative; z-index: 1; } .hero h1 { font-family: 'Noto Serif JP', serif; font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 4.3vw, 1.9rem); font-weight: 700; color: #fff; line-height: 1.55; max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto 14px; position: relative; z-index: 1; } .hero .date { font-size: .78rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,.65); position: relative; z-index: 1; } .container { max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 20px; } .lead-box { background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.05); padding: 24px 26px; margin: -24px auto 32px; position: relative; z-index: 2; font-size: .95rem; color: var(--ink2); } .lead-box p + p { margin-top: 12px; } .lead-box strong { color: var(--ink); } /* 記事内画像 */ figure.article-img { margin: 26px 0; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 3px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.12); } figure.article-img figcaption { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--ink2); padding: 11px 16px; background: #fff; } /* 日程表 */ .schedule { background: #fff; border: 2px solid var(--fire1); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; margin: 24px 0; } .schedule .sch-head { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--fire1), var(--fire2)); color: #fff; text-align: center; font-family: 'Noto Serif JP', serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 12px; } .schedule .sch-body { padding: 6px 0; } .schedule .sch-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 90px 1fr; padding: 12px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); font-size: .88rem; } .schedule .sch-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .schedule .sch-row dt { font-weight: 700; color: var(--fire1); } .schedule .sch-row dd { color: var(--ink2); } h2.sec { font-family: 'Noto Serif JP', serif; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); margin: 42px 0 18px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 3px solid var(--fire1); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } h2.sec .num { font-size: .9rem; color: #fff; background: var(--fire1); width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; } p.body { margin-bottom: 16px; color: var(--ink2); } p.body strong { color: var(--ink); } .info-box { background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 12px; padding: 6px 0; margin: 22px 0; } .info-box .row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 110px 1fr; padding: 12px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); font-size: .9rem; } .info-box .row:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .info-box .row dt { font-weight: 700; color: var(--night); }
